name: Meter
need: A horizontal progress/gauge to show a value on a fixed scale, with an optional target marker and tick labels. Needed for the AI/Run maturity score (value 1.4 of 3, target 2). No progress/meter primitive exists.

consideredAlternatives.whyNot: Shows the number, not the position on a scale.
That is exactly the hand-rolled inline JSX the constitution forbids; it recurs on every dashboard.

proposedApi.target: number? (renders a marker line + optional label)
proposedApi.ticks: number[] | boolean? (scale labels under the track)
proposedApi.label: string? (aria-label / visually-hidden description)
